rv.q: Would that all plays would be this tasty.
DOGS is a funny, fast-moving and only slightly disgusting eating competition.
Key ingredients have been left back in the kitchen.
It’s a clever, hilarious romp as well as a serious inquiry into the nature of competition.
I suggest that you go into this play ready to watch a wonderful story that will make you see why people compete in things that you think are crazy.

cn.t: This hot-dog eating contest comedy earns mixed reviews, with critics praising its clever premise and humor but noting tonal inconsistencies. Some find it a hilarious romp, while others feel its mix of broad comedy and earnestness doesn't quite gel.
